title: My Dream Is to Be the World's Number One Mascot

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come to the Tracen Meet that Aston
Machan told me about. A lot
of trainers
are here to see her after her performance
in the recent
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is she running today too? Look at
that—she's always got a smile
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's smiling just like always. She looks so
normal, you wouldn't even
be able to tell
anything happened yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still wonder why she invited me to come
and watch her at this
competition. No
answer seems to make sense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is starting, so I'll just have to wait
and find out.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Off with a clean dash, Aston Machan
makes her start!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks cool and collected as she waits
for the right time to push
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now we're into the homestretch! In third
position, Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She kicks up dirt with her short and quick
stride. It feels like she's
getting faster and
faster every time I blink.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan approaches from the
outside! From the outside, it's
Aston
Machan! Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She closes in on the leader, passes them,
and still continues to gather
speed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Taaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment she crosses the finish line is
so intense, vivid, and
fleeting...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"What's most important is the mark you
leave behind. A trace that
lives on even
after you're gone."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but something tells me I
shouldn't let her pass me
by.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... Whew! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She wins by a margin of a whole five
lengths! What's more, she's set a
new
record time!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, her—huh? Her cleat fell
off?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Murmur, murmur...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
F-for real?! She still managed that speed
while missing a cleat?! She's
on another
level!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I realize it, I'm on the move.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's an incredible talent. I need to try
and scout her one more ti...
Huh? That's
weird. You were here just a second ago.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I push my way through the sea of people
toward the green turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of breath, I make it to the finish line,
where I find Aston Machan
with her usual
smile.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I did a pretty good job out there,
didn't I? Go, me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I meant to say "I want to make a training
contract with you," but that's
what came
out of my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I meant to say "I want to make a training
contract with you," but that's
what came
out of my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Never forgets me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She probably won't understand what I'm
getting at. I start to fret,
wondering how I
can put it into words, but the right words
don't come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand why she told me to
come watch. It was to prove to
me that, in
a race, she can leave the most profound
mark on the
crowd out of anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The intensity of her running just now was
enough to make that
instantly clear. It's
burned into my memory, unlikely to ever
be
forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And I don't think I want to forget it either.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...When you saw me race, you wanted to
make sure I'd never be
forgotten?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Here's a test for you! When you look at
me, do you see a clear vision
of Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Have your eyes properly
captured her image?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since she's emphasizing it, I think I
understand. She's not talking in a
physical
sense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her ambition is to leave a profound mark
behind. To be known far
and wide. Not
just in Japan, but throughout the whole
world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she will continue to be. Not only in
my eyes, but the eyes of the
whole world,
forever. I manage to put that into words.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In the eyes of the whole world, forever...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I like that idea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've decided. I will turn your eyes into a
lens fixed exclusively on me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is that all right? It is, right? I'm assuming it
is. Well then, let's properly
introduce
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hello, I'm Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She enters into frame. The image is light
and fleeting. I strain my eyes
to capture it
in its entirety.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Nice to meet you.
